name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Plafing
beschreibung: The farm retreat Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Plafing is located in Ebbs, Tyrol, as part of an active agricultural estate. It offers several comfortably appointed holiday apartments of varying layouts. Nestled in the pristine Kaisergebirge nature region, guests enjoy doorstep access to scenic hiking paths and cycling routes. Cultural outings to the historic Kufstein Fortress or the nearby Ebbs Wildpark are effortlessly planned from here. The holiday flats boast contemporary furnishings alongside private balconies or terraces. Fresh regional products of the farm's own making are readily available, making this tranquil setting a haven for those seeking genuine Alpine relaxation.
